about.description: Single-stock perpetual futures market on QFEX tracking BitMine Immersion Technologies, Inc. 9.50% Series A Perpetual Preferred Stock, quoted in USD, cross-margined in USDC and trading 24/7 with up to 10x leverage. QFEX is a hybrid central-limit-order-book exchange for traditional assets only; positions are cash-settled and confer no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Reference prices are consumed from primary venues during the instrument's published reference-price hours and funding is zero outside them. BMNP is the 9.50% Series A Perpetual Preferred Stock of BitMine Immersion Technologies, Inc. (NYSE, listed 2026-06-16, $100 stated amount, weekly dividends) - a different security from BMNR, the common stock, which QFEX lists separately.
